newsitem.title: USA: EXEL plans to hold Mid Ocean stake.
newsitem.headline: EXEL plans to hold Mid Ocean stake.

text.p: Bermuda-based liability insurer EXEL Ltd said it has no near-term plans to sell its nearly 26-percent stake in Mid Ocean Ltd, despite its agreement last month to buy a Mid Ocean rival.
"At the moment, our plans are to hold our stock (in Mid Ocean)," EXEL chief financial officer Brian Walford said.
In addition, he said, the matter has not yet been discussed by EXEL's board.
Shares of Mid Ocean have posted sharp gains over the last two days amid speculation about Mid Ocean's strategic plans as the company prepares to report earnings on Friday.
